hook: Winning 2 Oscars changed how Mahershala Ali approaches his craft.

sections.voiceover: Winning 2 Oscars changed how Mahershala Ali approaches his craft.
b_roll: Portrait of Mahershala Ali holding an award
Close up shot on a dark film set

sections.voiceover: Did spending decades in the film business give Mahershala Ali a deep foundation?
b_roll: Film still from Swan Song showing dual characters

sections.voiceover: Yet winning 2 Oscars left Mahershala Ali less fearful and ready to push further.
b_roll: Stage lights focusing on an actor

sections.voiceover: Mahershala Ali used his 2 Oscars to unlock total experimentation. Mahershala Ali brought that experimental mindset to Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother. Mahershala Ali lets everyone fail on camera until they find an authentic performance.
b_roll: Director monitoring a camera screen on set
Actor performing in front of studio lights

sections.voiceover: He secured absolute creative freedom by winning 2 Academy Awards.

Film credits rolling in a dark theater
